items.text: The minimum age to buy or possess cannabis is 19. Adults may carry up to 30 g of dried cannabis (or equivalent) in a public place, and buy from stores licensed through the Newfoundland and Labrador Liquor Corporation (NLC) or NLC's online store. Buying or selling outside that system is an offence.

You can't use cannabis in a public place, a motor vehicle or a boat. Use is allowed in a private home or its yard, and may be allowed in a hotel room, an apartment or a rented campsite if the owner or operator permits (not in common areas). A vehicle used as a temporary or private residence may be an exception while it's parked off the road. Novice drivers, drivers under 22 and commercial drivers have zero tolerance for any detectable THC.

The legal drinking age is 19 (Liquor Control Act s. 72 and 76). You can't have open alcohol in a public place without a licence or permit, or be intoxicated in a public place (s. 77). In a motor vehicle, moving or not, alcohol must be unopened or packed away out of reach (s. 80).
